title: Bead rotating in water: rotary Stokes torque vs frequency (frequency response, mixed u-p, azimuthal order 1, analytic)
description:
Rotational microrheology geometry: a polystyrene bead of radius a = 1 um (E 3.5 GPa, nu 0.34, rho_b 1050 kg/m^3) in library water (viscosity mu = 1.002e-3 Pa s, rho = 998.2 kg/m^3, no bulk modulus: an incompressible viscous liquid, G* = j omega mu), turned harmonically by theta = 1 mrad about a transverse axis. Axisymmetric (r, z) with azimuthal_order 1 (u_r, u_z ~ cos phi, u_phi ~ sin phi, field u_z = the U_phi amplitude), the bead centre on the axis at z0 = 50 um, the container r < 50 um, 0 < z < 100 um with fixed walls (x_lo is the axis). The rigid rotation by theta about y through the centre, u = theta y_hat x (r - z0 z_hat), is U_r = theta (z - z0), U_phi = -theta (z - z0), U_z = -theta r: prescribed_displacement_domain 'bead' holds u_x = theta (y - z0), u_y = -theta x, u_z = -theta (y - z0) (x, y values, exact at every P2 node since the field is linear; on the axis U_phi = -U_r, the m = 1 tie). solid_mechanics on quadratic triangles (h = 0.12 um inside the bead, growth 1.25, 2.5 um at most), formulation mixed (Taylor-Hood: P2 displacement, P1 pressure per material), frequency_response at 8 log-spaced frequencies from 10 kHz to 1 MHz: s = a / delta = sqrt(f / f_nu) from 0.18 to 1.8 (delta = sqrt(2 mu / (rho omega)), f_nu = mu / (pi rho a^2) = 319 kHz).
Analytic (exp(+j omega t); the unsteady Stokes rotlet, cf. Landau-Lifshitz Fluid Mechanics section 24, problems):the motion is pure shear, div u = 0, so the pressure vanishes and rho (j omega)^2 u = G* lap u: u = theta F(rho) y_hat x r' with rho = |r'| from the centre, F(rho) = (a / rho)^3 (1 + lam rho) exp(-lam (rho - a)) / (1 + lam a) (the modified spherical Bessel k1 shape; F(a) = 1), lam = j omega sqrt(rho / G*) = sqrt(j omega rho / mu) = (1 + j) / delta, Re lam > 0. The wall shear stress tau_r_phi = G* rho d/drho (u_phi / rho) = -G* theta sin(polar angle) (3 + 3 lam a + lam^2 a^2) / (1 + lam a), and the torque of the water on the bead T = int a sin tau dA = -8 pi a^3 G* theta Phi, Phi = (1 + lam a + lam^2 a^2 / 3) / (1 + lam a) = 1 + 2 j s^2 / (3 (1 + s + j s)): Re Phi = 1 + 2 s^3 / (3 D), Im Phi = 2 s^2 (1 + s) / (3 D), D = (1 + s)^2 + s^2 (omega -> 0: the Kirchhoff rotlet torque 8 pi mu a^3 Omega, Omega = j omega theta). Reaction: the reaction table's W = sum R u_held over the bead's held dofs is the work of the support on the rigid rotation, W = theta T_R, T_R the torque about +y the support exerts on the bead; the bead rotates rigidly, so -omega^2 I_b theta = T_R + T with I_b = 8/15 pi rho_b a^5: W = theta^2 (8 pi mu a^3 omega (j Re Phi - Im Phi) - omega^2 I_b), i.e. W_im = theta^2 8 pi mu a^3 omega Re Phi (omega Im W / 2 = the dissipated power) and W_re = -theta^2 (8 pi mu a^3 omega Im Phi + omega^2 I_b). Probe 'probe' at r = z - z0 = sqrt(2) a (distance 2 a): U_r = -U_phi = -U_z = sqrt(2) a theta F(2 a), F(2 a) = (1 + 2 lam a) exp(-lam a) / (8 (1 + lam a)). Verified independently of the FEM (scratch script: the ODE g'' + 2 g' / r - 2 g / r^2 - lam^2 g = 0 of g = rho F by finite differences to 1e-6, the wall stress and the quadrature torque to 4e-8, the Stokes limit, the real-valued curve formulas against the complex closed form to 4e-16, the probe amplitudes against a projection of the 3D field). Container: the rotlet decays as (a / rho)^2 and is screened by exp(-(rho - a) / delta); the closed form of a spherical container at 50 a (A k1(lam r) + B i1(lam r), u = 0 on the wall) shifts the torque by 1e-10 at 10 kHz ((R - a) / delta = 8.7) and less above, the Stokes bound (a / R)^3 = 8e-6, so the cylinder (every wall at >= 49 a) is far enough.
Curves & tables tab: the bead reaction W_re (the inertia of bead and boundary layer, in phase with -theta) and W_im (the dissipative torque times theta) versus frequency with their analytic curves; the derived curve torque_ratio_vs_closed_form = Im W / (theta^2 8 pi mu a^3 omega Re Phi) over the analytic 1 (per table row); the probe's U_phi (series u_z_re / u_z_im) with their analytic curves (the k1 decay of the swirl two radii out). Derived values tab: the dissipative torque ratio Im W / (theta^2 8 pi mu a^3 omega) at 10 kHz and 1 MHz against Re Phi, and max |p| over the wall shear amplitude |tau| at 1 MHz against 0 (the u-p coupling check: at m = 1 U_phi enters div u = dU_r/dr + (U_r + U_phi) / r + dU_z/dz, which the rotation keeps 0 only through U_phi = -U_r; a coupling error would give |p| ~ |tau|). Field tab: u_abs, u_z (U_phi) and the pressure (only discretisation error) of the last frequency. Expected agreement (h = 0.12 um in the bead, growth 1.25, 5,955 triangles, about 6 s on one cpu thread; curves relative to their range): torque ratios 2.6e-5 (10 kHz) and 1.7e-5 (1 MHz), curves W_re 3.4e-5, W_im 1.7e-5, torque_ratio_vs_closed_form 2.6e-5, probe U_phi re / im 1.5e-4 / 1.6e-4, max |p| / |tau| 2.0e-3; tolerances 3-4x that (the pressure 2.5x). Mesh study h_bead = 0.24, 0.12, 0.06 um (4,977, 5,955, 8,389 triangles): torque ratio at 10 kHz 1.2e-4, 2.6e-5, 1.0e-5, W_re 2.5e-4, 3.4e-5, 3.7e-6, max |p| / |tau| 3.8e-3, 2.0e-3, 8.8e-4 (about first order: the P1 pressure next to the bead surface); the probe (1.5e-4 at every h_bead) and the rest of the torque error follow the water mesh around the bead: growth 1.12 gives probe 4.2e-5 and torque 8.4e-6, growth 1.12 with h_bead 0.06 um probe 3.0e-5, torque 1.6e-6, pressure 5.7e-4, while h_max 1.25 um changes nothing, so the residual is discretisation error.

parameters.name: theta_b
parameters.description: prescribed rotation amplitude of the bead about y [rad]

parameters.name: R_c
parameters.description: container radius and half height (the bead centre height z0)

parameters.name: h_bead
parameters.description: triangle size inside the bead (delta(1 MHz) / 4.7)

parameters.name: f_nu
parameters.description: frequency where delta = a [Hz] (a / delta = sqrt(f / f_nu))

parameters.name: T_s
parameters.description: rotary Stokes coefficient [N m s] (torque 8 pi mu a^3 Omega)

parameters.name: I_b
parameters.description: moment of inertia of the bead about a diameter [kg m^2]

parameters.name: s_lo
parameters.description: a / delta at the lowest frequency

parameters.name: s_hi
parameters.description: a / delta at the highest frequency

parameters.name: tau_hi
parameters.description: wall shear stress amplitude |tau| = |G*| theta |3 + 3 lam a + lam^2 a^2| / |1 + lam a| at the highest frequency [Pa]

derived_curves.name: torque_ratio_vs_closed_form
derived_curves.label: Im W / (theta^2 8 pi mu a^3 omega Re Phi), per table row
